text: Reminds me of my time in Tokyo with a vegetarian friend. Please move on if you read this story before, I may have shared it here before. Apparently Japanese has no word for “vegetarian” so my friend memorizes the words “yasAi dAke” which means “vegetables only.” Every restaurant we go to, he chants this mantra, then says “no meat” in English, and the first question is, “is fish ok, then.” After asking more questions, some of them eventually would say, “what do you eat, then?” And he would come back to “vegetables only."
